steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Digestion: breaks down large, insoluble food molecules into small, soluble molecules that can be absorbed into the bloodstream. Mechanical digestion physically breaks food apart; chemical digestion uses enzymes to break molecules apart.

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Name the enzyme that breaks down starch and state where it is produced. (2 marks) | Describe how bile helps the digestion of fats. (3 marks) | Explain why an enzyme denatures at high temperature. (3 marks)
